summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the adoption of its Seventh Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association, effective June 12, 2026, following a special resolution passed at its annual general meeting. The filing also includes press releases announcing AGM results. The restated governing documents adjust authorized share capital into 24,114,698,720 Class A and 885,301,280 Class B ordinary shares. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation event is disclosed. This is a routine corporate governance update for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K reporting charter amendments and meeting outcomes. No deal terms, premiums, dates, or advisors are present. No risk-arb angle exists.
